title: 157 Sunflower Street Vacation Rental
meta_description: 157 Sunflower Street is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Discover coastal luxury at its finest at 157 Sunflower Street, an exceptional WaterColor retreat designed for relaxation and style. Featuring a private pool, spacious living areas, and refined coastal décor, this six-bedroom home, including a carriage house, accommodates up to 12 guests and offers easy access to WaterColor’s pools, Beach Club, and Seaside.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included New Private Pool (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Exterior Shower Outdoor Fire Pit Propane Grill and Egg Grill Parking for 1 Vehicle 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access Experience the Home Welcome to 157 Sunflower Street, a stunning designer home offering a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort in WaterColor’s peaceful Crossing District. This custom-built retreat combines luxurious finishes, spacious interiors, and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces for a truly elevated 30A experience. The open-concept first floor features soaring ceilings and natural light that flows throughout the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The gourmet kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, elegant countertops, and a large island perfect for casual dining. The adjoining dining area seats the entire group comfortably, creating an inviting space for family meals and evening conversation. The main-level primary suite features a king bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub, providing a serene retreat after a day at the beach. A laundry room and half bathroom complete this level. Upstairs, a secondary living area with a plush sectional sofa and flat-screen TV offers a relaxed space for kids or guests to unwind. The second floor includes two king guest suites, each with private bathrooms, and two queen guest bedrooms with private baths and access to a balcony overlooking the pool area. For guests seeking extra privacy, the carriage house provides an additional king suite with a sitting area, kitchenette, and private bath. Step outside to enjoy the private pool, outdoor comfortable seating, and both a propane grill and egg grill, perfect for entertaining and outdoor dining. With a 6-passenger electric cart and six adult bikes included, guests can easily explore the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and nearby Seaside. From morning swims to sunset rides along 30A, 157 Sunflower Street offers an unforgettable WaterColor escape filled with luxury, leisure, and lasting memories.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Half Bathroom Second Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Secondary Living Area Carriage House: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Sitting Area and Kitchenette with Mini-Fridge and Sink Life in WaterColor Located in the Crossing District, this elegant retreat offers access to the best of 30A living. Enjoy the private pool, nearby Dragonfly Pool, and the short rides to the Beach Club and Seaside. Whether lounging poolside or exploring the coast by electric cart or bike, 157 Sunflower Street delivers the ultimate WaterColor getaway.
